resources.string: Community artwork for completing app icons. Sync a snapshot explicitly, then choose a style and generate locally.

Perfect Icons Completion Project collects icon artwork contributed by the community. KeiHome uses a local snapshot to complete matching app icons or generate a native icon ZIP. Available styles and coverage depend on that snapshot. Opening this page only reads local data; Sync repository starts a download.
Historical packaging reference. KeiHome generates its own native ZIPs; this link is provided for attribution.
